items.title: 6.3 Applications and Implications of Cloud Computing (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: Cloud computing ne karobar aur afraad ke data sambhalne, process karne aur rakhne ka andaaz badal diya hai. Is ke istemal kai shobon mein phaile hain, websites host karne aur applications chalane se data rakhne aur mil kar kaam karne tak, jo idaron ki IT laagat kam aur tabdeeli par jaldi rad-e-amal mein madad deta hai. Is ke kuch asraat bhi hain jinhein sambhalna zaroori hai.

blocks.prompt: Cloud computing ke teen istemal aur do asraat bataiye.
blocks.explanation: Istemal: data storage, web hosting aur content delivery, machine learning aur AI. Asraat: data security aur laagat ka intezam (aur scalability ka intezam aur qawaneen ki pabandi).

items: Cloud: wasee istemal, aur hifazat, wasail, laagat aur qawaneen ke asraat.
